Web scraping and text processing

Website Content Summarization

Turn scattered program pages into a dataset you can import.

Problem
Program descriptions live on different sites and are hard to collect in a consistent format.
Approach
A Python script finds About and Programs pages, parses their HTML with Beautiful Soup, and falls back to a browser when needed. It extracts the first two sentences from the retrieved text.
Output
A CSV of short descriptions formatted for WordPress import.

Team hackathon project

TradeOps Reconciler

How do you know a settlement correction took effect if the reply got lost?

Problem
A rejected settlement instruction needs a correction. If the worker stops or the reply never comes back, applying it again could duplicate the change.
Approach
Our team built a prototype that compares broker, custodian, and account directory records. An operator approves an exact amendment. MongoDB Atlas stores the intent before the worker sends the correction.
Demo
After a worker restart, the prototype reads the simulated custodian’s receipt and instruction to verify whether the approved change took effect.

React · FastAPI · MongoDB Atlas · Voyage
